description: This file defines classes and configuration structures for creating, customizing, and managing dialog windows within the CKEditor rich text editor. It includes definitions for dialogs, dialog contents, buttons, and UI elements, along with associated properties, examples, and documentation comments.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.dialogDefinition
classes.description: Represents the properties and configurations for defining a dialog, its contents, and behaviors, including title, size, buttons, contents, and callback functions.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.contentDefinition
classes.description: Defines individual content pages within a dialog, including properties like id, label, title, accessKey, and contained UI elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.buttonDefinition
classes.description: Describes the configuration of dialog buttons, including id, label, title, accessKey, disabled state, and click handler.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.uiElementDefinition
classes.description: Represents individual UI elements within a dialog content page, with properties such as id, type, title, style, className, and event handlers.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.dialog.add
methods.description: Function to register and add a new dialog definition to the editor.
